summary: Pre-launch check (iteration 113) on the preview URL. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter113_prelaunch.py -> 19/19 passed (auth login/me/wrong-pw/401, recipes list guest+auth (121 recipes, no _id, menu_category + localized names present), public GETs site-settings/news/shop/newsletter-count/challenges-catalog/bakealong-current, community posts+market logged, weekly-plan, challenges state, AI quiz POST /api/academy/quiz works BOTH as guest and logged). No 5xx observed anywhere. Frontend (mobile 390x844, EN default, guest + fornaio@mikilab.de): app loads with no error boundary, no page JS errors; all 5 bottom-nav tabs navigate OK; login via login-btn/auth-tab-login/auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit works; recipe list + 6 colored category filters (cat-filter-all/basi/viennoiserie/pane/focacce/snack) filter correctly (pane -> only cat-section-pane, all -> 5 sections) and recipe-cat-icon-* badges render inside expanded cat-folder-*; RicetteCustodite detail (custodite-open-*) shows custodite-improver-note + miglioratore-detail-toggle ('My Improver: learn more') which expands all 5 miglioratore-ing-0..4 correctly localized; recipe detail dialog has the 6-language selector (recipe-lang-*); LabWizard: 33% -> mark-2 -> 67% -> mark-3 -> 100% + lab-wizard-complete + lab-wizard-generate-today (clicked, plan generated, no crash), summary/byDay chips/shopping (flour 25.44kg, water 21.56kg, preferment 5.09kg) + shop-expand with flours by type, reset OK; GROUPED RECIPE SELECTS verified in BOTH Weekly Plan (weekly-recipe-select-*) and Impara (home-product-recipe-0): 5 optgroups with translated section titles ('Bases & Leavens', 'Leavened Pastry & Viennoiserie', 'Bread & Baked Goods', 'Focaccia & Savory Leavened', 'Snacks & Savory Bites'); Impara quiz (quiz-start -> quiz-question-card) loads an AI question in ~6s BOTH as guest and logged; bake-along card present; Community guest -> community-auth-gate, logged -> community-board-heading + 4 community-post-*; Home: home-market-promo, home-personal-photo, 4 home-quickstart-* chips (navigate correctly), NO newsletter widget in Home (newsletter present only in Impara, 6 elements). Avatars clickable and navigating in Home/Ricette/Impara. ONE GAP: AvatarBubbles are NOT rendered in 'Il tuo Laboratorio'.

ui_bugs.issue: AvatarBubbles is imported (line 52) but NEVER rendered -> no bubble-michele / bubble-momy / bubble-hint-lab / assistant-dot in the Lab section (measured count 0 both as guest and logged). Consequently the lab-specific actions in AvatarBubbles (michele -> openLabTool('aggiungi'), momy -> scroll to [data-testid=lab-wizard']) and the lab hint (weekly-plan-based) are dead code. variant="lab" is used nowhere in the codebase.

Reproduced again: the popup (data-testid=newsletter-popup, fixed inset-0 z-[85]) appears with a delay (seen while on the Lab tab) and intercepts pointer events on the whole bottom nav -> all nav-tab-* clicks time out until newsletter-popup-close is pressed. Blocks real users mid-navigation.

integration_issues.issue: Search only matches the LOCALIZED fields (rLoc name/real_name/flour_type). With UI in EN, searching the canonical Italian name ('Anima', 'Anima Integrale') returns recipe-no-results; only the EN title ('Whole Soul') matches. Users/bakers who know the Italian names cannot find the recipe.

issues: The dynamic hint button (bubble-hint-home) and the 'Take me there' CTA are rendered inline with no separation: text reads '👉 Try this week's challenge!Take me there →'. Add a line break / margin between hint and CTA.
Still low contrast: sub-text 'Register to see the feed, colleagues, marketplace and join the challenges.' is mid-grey on the full-orange card (carried over from iteration 112).
Floating 'Radio' FAB bottom-left keeps overlapping list/wizard content (carried over from iteration 112).

action_items: Render <AvatarBubbles variant="lab" /> in sections/Maestro.jsx (Il tuo Laboratorio) - currently imported but unused, so avatars/hint/dot are missing in the Lab section.
Prevent NewsletterPopup from opening while the user is interacting (or at least stop it intercepting the bottom nav) - it fully blocks navigation until closed.
Optional: include the canonical (Italian) recipe name in the RecipeList search haystack so searching 'Anima Integrale' works in every language.
Optional: spacing between bubble-hint-* and the 'Take me there' CTA; contrast of community-auth-gate sub-text.
critical_code_review_comments: sections/Maestro.jsx: unused import AvatarBubbles (line 52) - the intended lab avatars were never wired; ESLint config does not flag unused imports, so this slipped through.
components/RecipeOptions.jsx is correct and shared by WeeklyPlan and Beginners (no duplication) - grouping + localized titles verified live.
RecipeList.jsx (1259 lines), PianoProduzioneAI.jsx, WeeklyPlan.jsx (851 lines) still exceed the 700-line guideline.
No GET /api/recipes/{id} route exists (returns 405); detail data is taken from the list payload - acceptable but note it if a deep-link/detail endpoint is ever needed.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (7.5/8 requested areas; only Lab avatars missing)

rca_of_the_issue: Lab avatars: AvatarBubbles was imported into sections/Maestro.jsx but the JSX element was never added (variant='lab' unused across the repo), so all lab-variant logic in AvatarBubbles.jsx (weekly-plan hint, openLabTool('aggiungi'), scroll-to-wizard) is unreachable. Fix = add <AvatarBubbles variant="lab" /> near the top of the Maestro tool-hub render.
